title: Skinwalker Ridge landscape photo, BAASS Utah Ranch investigation section cover
description: Section title page "(B) Recent Investigation of Reports from Witnesses who Live in the Area Surrounding the Utah Ranch Property" with the BAASS logo and a color photograph of an eroded red-and-gray sandstone ridge above a band of trees and green scrub. Captions read "Skinwalker Ridge (As named by Ute Tribal members over several generations)" and "Utah Ranch – November 16-19, 2009"; investigator names are redacted as AAP Person 41 and AAP Person 14.
